# Wczytywanie bibliotek i danych z ćwiczenia 2

```{r}
library(tidymodels) 
library(skimr) 
library(GGally) 
library(openair)
library(lubridate)
library(future)
library(ggplot2)
tidymodels_prefer()
set.seed(222)

air <- mydata |> selectByDate(year = 2002) 
air |> skim()
air <- air |> na.omit()

air <-
  air |>
  mutate(ozone = cut(
    o3,
    breaks = c(-0.1, 10, 53),
    labels = c("Niskie", "Wysokie")
  ))

air |> count(ozone)

air_prepared <- air |> 
  mutate(
    month = month(date),
    day_of_year = yday(date),
    is_weekend = ifelse(wday(date) %in% c(1, 7), 1, 0)
  )

# Sprawdzenie korelacji
cat("\nKorelacja NO2 z O3:", cor(air_prepared$no2, air_prepared$o3), "\n")
cat("Korelacja NOX z O3:", cor(air_prepared$nox, air_prepared$o3), "\n")

air_split <- initial_split(air_prepared, 
                           prop = 0.75, 
                           strata = ozone)
air_train <- training(air_split)
air_test <- testing(air_split)

ozone_recipe <- recipe(ozone ~ ., data = air_train) |>
  step_rm(date, o3, co, nox, wd) |>
  step_YeoJohnson(pm10, pm25, so2, no2, ws) |>
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors()) |>
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors())
```

# Resampling

## Cross Validation

```{r}
logistic_spec <- logistic_reg() |>
  set_engine("glm") |>
  set_mode("classification")

logistic_wf <- workflow() |>
  add_recipe(ozone_recipe) |>
  add_model(logistic_spec)

air_folds <- vfold_cv(air_train, v = 10, strata = ozone)

cv_logistic <- fit_resamples(
  logistic_wf,
  resamples = air_folds,
  metrics = metric_set(accuracy, roc_auc, sens, spec, precision),
  control = control_resamples(save_pred = TRUE)
)

cv_logistic_metrics <- collect_metrics(cv_logistic)
cv_logistic_metrics
```

## Random Forest

```{r}
rf_spec <- rand_forest(
  trees = 500,
  mtry = tune(),
  min_n = tune()
) |>
  set_engine("ranger", importance = "permutation") |>
  set_mode("classification")

rf_wf <- workflow() |>
  add_recipe(ozone_recipe) |>
  add_model(rf_spec)

rf_grid <- grid_random(
  parameters(mtry() %>% range_set(c(2, 8)), min_n()),
  size = 10
)

cv_rf <- tune_grid(
  rf_wf,
  resamples = air_folds,
  grid = rf_grid,
  metrics = metric_set(accuracy, roc_auc, sens, spec),
  control = control_resamples(save_pred = TRUE)
)

best_rf_params <- select_best(cv_rf, metric = "roc_auc")

cv_rf_final <- finalize_workflow(rf_wf, best_rf_params)
cv_rf_results <- fit_resamples(cv_rf_final, resamples = air_folds,
                              metrics = metric_set(accuracy, roc_auc, sens, spec))

cv_rf_metrics <- collect_metrics(cv_rf_results)
cv_rf_metrics
```

# V-krotna Cross Validation

## Cross Validation

```{r}
vfold_comparison_logistic <- function(v_values) {
  results <- list()
  
  for(v in v_values) {
    folds <- vfold_cv(air_train, v = v, strata = ozone)
    
    cv_result <- fit_resamples(
      logistic_wf,
      resamples = folds,
      metrics = metric_set(accuracy, roc_auc, sens, spec)
    )
    
    results[[paste0("V", v)]] <- collect_metrics(cv_result) |>
      mutate(v_folds = v)
  }
  
  bind_rows(results)
}

v_values <- c(5, 10, 15)
vfold_logistic_results <- vfold_comparison_logistic(v_values)
vfold_logistic_results
```

## Random Forest

```{r}
vfold_comparison_rf <- function(v_values) {
  results <- list()
  
  for(v in v_values) {
    folds <- vfold_cv(air_train, v = v, strata = ozone)
    
    rf_simple <- rand_forest(trees = 200) |>
      set_engine("ranger") |>
      set_mode("classification")
    
    rf_wf_simple <- workflow() |>
      add_recipe(ozone_recipe) |>
      add_model(rf_simple)
    
    cv_result <- fit_resamples(
      rf_wf_simple,
      resamples = folds,
      metrics = metric_set(accuracy, roc_auc, sens, spec)
    )
    
    results[[paste0("V", v)]] <- collect_metrics(cv_result) |>
      mutate(v_folds = v)
  }
  
  bind_rows(results)
}

vfold_rf_results <- vfold_comparison_rf(v_values)
vfold_rf_results
```

# Bootstrap

## Bootstrap

```{r}
bootstraps <- bootstraps(air_train, times = 100, strata = ozone)

boot_logistic <- fit_resamples(
  logistic_wf,
  resamples = bootstraps,
  metrics = metric_set(accuracy, roc_auc, sens, spec)
)

boot_logistic_metrics <- collect_metrics(boot_logistic)
boot_logistic_metrics

boot_logistic_details <- collect_metrics(boot_logistic, summarize = FALSE)
```

## Random Forest

```{r}
rf_simple <- rand_forest(trees = 200) |>
  set_engine("ranger") |>
  set_mode("classification")

rf_wf_simple <- workflow() |>
  add_recipe(ozone_recipe) |>
  add_model(rf_simple)

boot_rf <- fit_resamples(
  rf_wf_simple,
  resamples = bootstraps,
  metrics = metric_set(accuracy, roc_auc, sens, spec)
)

boot_rf_metrics <- collect_metrics(boot_rf)
boot_rf_metrics

boot_rf_details <- collect_metrics(boot_rf, summarize = FALSE)
```

# Porównanie metod

```{r}
comparison_table <- bind_rows(
  cv_logistic_metrics |> mutate(model = "Logistic_CV", method = "10-fold CV"),
  cv_rf_metrics |> mutate(model = "RF_CV", method = "10-fold CV"),
  boot_logistic_metrics |> mutate(model = "Logistic_Boot", method = "Bootstrap"),
  boot_rf_metrics |> mutate(model = "RF_Boot", method = "Bootstrap")
) |>
  select(model, method, .metric, mean, std_err, n)

comparison_table
```

## Wykresy

```{r}
# Wykres porównawczy AUC
auc_comparison <- comparison_table |>
  filter(.metric == "roc_auc") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = model, y = mean, fill = method)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - std_err, ymax = mean + std_err),
                position = position_dodge(0.9), width = 0.2) +
  labs(title = "Porównanie AUC dla różnych metod resamplingu",
       y = "AUC", x = "Model i metoda") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2")

auc_comparison

# Wykres porównawczy dokładności
accuracy_comparison <- comparison_table |>
  filter(.metric == "accuracy") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = model, y = mean, fill = method)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - std_err, ymax = mean + std_err),
                position = position_dodge(0.9), width = 0.2) +
  labs(title = "Porównanie dokładności dla różnych metod resamplingu",
       y = "Accuracy", x = "Model i metoda") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1")

accuracy_comparison
```

# Modele

## Finalny model regresji logistycznej

```{r}
final_logistic <- fit(logistic_wf, air_train)

test_pred_logistic <- augment(final_logistic, air_test)

logistic_test_metrics <- metric_set(accuracy, roc_auc, sens, spec)(
  test_pred_logistic,
  truth = ozone,
  estimate = .pred_class,
  .pred_Wysokie
)

logistic_test_metrics
```

## Finalny model random forest

```{r}
final_rf_wf <- finalize_workflow(rf_wf, best_rf_params)
final_rf <- fit(final_rf_wf, air_train)

test_pred_rf <- augment(final_rf, air_test)

rf_test_metrics <- metric_set(accuracy, roc_auc, sens, spec)(
  test_pred_rf,
  truth = ozone,
  estimate = .pred_class,
  .pred_Wysokie
)

rf_test_metrics
```

# Wnioski


**Random Forest przewyższa regresję logistyczną** pod względem AUC i ogólnej wydajności, wykazując przy tym większą stabilność wyników.

**10-krotna CV okazała się optymalną metodą walidacji** - zapewnia wiarygodne estymaty przy rozsądnym koszcie obliczeniowym. Bootstrap natomiast może zawyżać wyniki, szczególnie na małych zbiorach.

**Random Forest demonstruje mniejszą wariancję** między różnymi metodami resamplingu, podczas gdy regresja logistyczna jest bardziej wrażliwa na zmiany w danych.
